git_read_commands: GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0 git -C SOURCE ls-files; no git status/log/show/diff or source mutation
limitations: Integrity window begins with inventory before copying, after discovery reads; cannot prove source state before that point.
Checks exclude source .git metadata; only working-area file bytes, sizes, modes and mtimes compared.
Historical tests, approval conversations, external claims and references not independently reverified.
Selective copies preserve raw internal links even when target not collected.
execution_deviations: Initial absolute-path rg file enumeration used insufficient .git/** exclusion and returned .git object/ref/worktree metadata path names. Did not open those contents or read history; later os.walk pruned .git and rg used !**/.git/**.
Initial two read-only searches used source workdir; all later operations used assigned worktree.
An initial read-only inventory used unavailable python command; reran using python3.
